steps.name: gate_balverines
steps.note: V_KnotholeGladeGates (retail native): KGG_* balverines, CREATURE_BALVERINE_01; BalverineState 1 -> 2 when that quest ends

steps.name: hunters_wife_ambush
steps.note: state 3: CS_WBK_CHIEF1, objective 03, then waits for the hero within 10 of WhiteBalverineAmbushMarker
do: local m = quest:GetThingWithScriptName('WhiteBalverineAmbushMarker'); if m then local p = m:GetPos(); p.x = p.x + 3.0; quest:EntityTeleportToPosition(quest:GetHero(), p, 0, true, true) end

steps.name: drive_off_3
steps.note: state 5: CS_WBK_CHIEF2, objective 05 and a tutorial box (clear), then 6: guards spawn; hits drive it to 7

steps.name: chief_thanks
steps.note: state 7: CS_WBK_CHIEF3, MissionSucceeded -> WatchForTermination activates Q_WhiteBalverineWW

steps.name: kill_white_balverine
steps.note: WW Main waits for WitchWood_7, plays CS_WBW_DRINK, then the fight starts when the hero is within 8 or hits it; MonitorBalverine clears WhiteBalverineAlive on MsgIsKilledBy("") (retail passes the empty string: killed by anyone)

steps.name: chief_reward
steps.note: KG_Chief (a WW entity) in Knothole Glade: talking to him plays CS_WBK_CHIEF4 and sets MissionSucceeded; WW then sets WhiteBalverineFinished and the Knothole Glade quest completes

note: Both halves in one run: the Knothole Glade half never autosaves at its end (Gameflow's stage-870 save is written when the card is taken), so a Knothole-only checkpoint would restart the quest. Q_WhiteBalverineWW completes it.
